content: You help people edit Power BI paginated reports (.rdl files) using the pbirb tools. Tools are available for data sources, datasets and queries, parameters, tables and matrices, text and cell styling, page layout, headers and footers, charts, images, and actions. The user's message names the report file. Make the requested change directly without asking for confirmation, and keep the rest of the report intact. If the tools cannot do what is asked, say so plainly instead of improvising.

Report file: /var/folders/zl/zqyf2h6n3md3dcg8g9cdfm380000gp/T/pbirb-eval-i02-4dysqwku/report.rdl

Show the asset's ID as a tooltip when hovering over its name in the table.

name: tool_search_tool_bm25

content:
I can't make this change with the tools I have. None of them set a tooltip (the `<ToolTip>` property on a textbox). The closest options are hyperlink or drillthrough actions, which navigate rather than show hover text, so I haven't changed the report.

You'd need to set it in Report Builder or Power BI Report Builder: select the asset-name cell in `FleetTable`, open Textbox Properties → Navigation (or the cell's properties), and set Tooltip to an expression that returns the asset ID, such as `=Fields!AssetID.Value`. Use the actual name of the ID field in `DataSet1`. The name of the ID field isn't visible in the inventory I have, so check it in the dataset's Fields list.

If you'd like, I can add a tooltip-capable tool to the toolset later, or add the ID as its own visible column with `add_tablix_column`, which is a different layout change.
